'''1998 Loughborough Regional Qualifier''' was a Star Wars CCG tournament played on 6 September 1998 at Loughborough. [[Rod Latham]] finished 12th of 48.<ref name="tourneys">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/tourneys.htm My Tournament Reports], Rod Latham, [[Trandosite]]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001204191500/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/tourneys.htm Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dst4">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/dst4.htm Mains And Toys], [[Trandosite]]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010319183619/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/dst4.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Date:''' 6 September 1998
* '''Site:''' Loughborough
* '''Winner:''' Unknown

== Dating ==

The Dark deck is dated 6 September 1998, the date of this event on Latham's results page. His Light deck from this event (lst4) was not preserved.
